decisive_items: diffuse bilateral cortical and subcortical edema in cortical and subcortical white matter bilaterally
response.rationale: R3 and R6 share the same raw imaging span, but the diffuse bilateral edema is more typical of toxic encephalopathy than PRES, which usually has posterior predominance. R5's raw spans only document seizures without any toxic cause, so it is incomplete.

rejected.why: Raw spans only show seizure activity, not the toxic cause stated in the label.
